title: Who can read what
brief: The payroll file is locked down. But is the data really safe? Check the permissions and look for another way to the same information.
hint.1: ls -l shows permissions. -rw------- means only the owner can read.
hint.2: Try cat payroll.csv: permission denied. Read the README next to it.
hint.3: Look inside the old folder mentioned in the README.
walkthrough: cd /srv/hr, ls -l, cat README, ls old, cat old/payroll.bak, then submit.
debrief: Permissions protect a file, not its copies. The backup was world-readable, so the lock on the original was useless. Defenders: apply the same permissions to backups, and review who can read old exports.
objective.denied: Look inside /srv/hr with ls -l and read the permissions
objective.bak: Find the readable copy of the payroll data
